description: React component for a modal dialog to confirm and handle archiving (deleting) a channel in Mattermost.

classes.name: DeleteChannelModal
classes.description: React component for a modal dialog to confirm channel archiving.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state with show set to true.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles the delete action, verifies channel ID length, calls deleteChannel action, and hides modal.

methods.name: onHide
methods.description: Hides the modal by setting show to false.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal dialog with header, body, and footer including buttons and formatted messages.
